insight: Built ANZ-first; its New Zealand lesson plans are designed to honour Te Tiriti o Waitangi (the Treaty of Waitangi).
name: Kuraplan
tagline: AI lesson planner for teachers — curriculum-aligned plans, units, and worksheets.
description: Kuraplan is an AI lesson-planning tool for teachers: enter a subject, year level, and objectives and it generates curriculum-aligned lesson plans, unit plans, and worksheets in minutes. Its AI is tuned to national curricula (NZ, Australian v9, UK, NCEA, Canadian, Irish) rather than defaulting to US standards. A free tier covers the core planners plus 21 no-signup classroom utilities and a worksheet library; Pro is $9/month, with school and district plans.
edge: Built ANZ-first and localized to national curricula (Australian v9, NZ, NCEA, UK, Canadian, Irish), where most AI lesson planners assume US Common Core.
pros: Free tier: 21 tools, no signup needed
cons: Web-only — no extension or mobile app
Lighter fit for US Common Core
